entities.name: Piotr Hofmański
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Piotr Józef Hofmański is a Polish jurist who served as President of the International Criminal Court (ICC) from 2021 to 2024 and as a judge of the ICC from 2015 to 2024. Prior to this tenure, Hofmański was a legal expert and advisor at the Council of Europe.
